notes.title: DLC4 Delayed Release Announcement
notes.notes: Due to some material issues, DLC4 needs to be delayed and will now be released next week. As a result, we will be releasing 2 DLCs simultaneously next week. To show our appreciation to the wide player base, we will be making DLC5 free of charge.

notes.title: Studio Update
notes.notes:
We are currently in the final stages of polishing our upcoming game "Goddess of War". This game is primarily targeted towards the China region players, and we hope it will provide you with an exciting card battle adventure. Utilize your wisdom to captivate the hearts of the various goddesses~
The game's Steam store page is now live, so feel free to click and add it to your wishlist.

Additionally, we are also developing a new game called "Rise & Muse". This is our first attempt at creating a card game using 3D technology, and we expect it to release on August 16th. We hope you will follow the development closely and add it to your wishlist as well.
We will continue to work hard to bring you even better gaming experiences. Thank you for your constant support and attention.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! First of all, we want to express our gratitude for your support in our game. You guys are absolutely amazing! Today, we bring you the V1.0.7 version update, and let me tell you, this update is really something special! We've addressed two issues, and I'm going to tell you about them right away! Listen up:

Did you know? In the 1600*900 resolution, the "Skip Story" button mysteriously disappeared! Isn't that strange? But don't worry, we've brought it back in this version! Now you can freely skip the storyline to your heart's content!

We know that some players may get stuck in battles and not know what to do, right? Well, we're the thoughtful game developers! So, we've added a super bonus for you! After failing once, you can choose to "Skip Battle" and easily get rid of those pesky enemies! Pretty amazing, huh? We've gone the extra mile to save you some brain cells. We really put a lot of thought into it!

So, dear players, please continue to stay tuned for our updates! We will keep working hard to bring you more laughter and surprises! Thank you all! We love you! 😄

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Based on your feedback over the past period, we have further optimized the combat system of the game to reduce issues with the flow of battles getting stuck.

Furthermore, in response to your feedback, we have implemented a skip feature for post-victory scenes, allowing you to progress through the game more quickly and enjoy the subsequent gameplay with ease.

We deeply apologize for any bugs or negative experiences you may have encountered previously. We are committed to providing timely updates to enhance your gaming enjoyment.

Additionally, our development team is considering the release of a DLC that will offer additional perks and content for the characters. We greatly appreciate your continued support!

Thank you for your understanding and support!

Update Date: March 18, 2024
